about: Mumbai-focused real estate developer building affordable, mid-income and luxury housing plus retail, commercial and school spaces, with marquee projects such as Runwal Gardens (Dombivli), Runwal Bliss (Kanjurmarg) and Runwal Greens (Mulund). As of Mar-26 it had 19 completed, 28 ongoing and 33 upcoming projects with 88.37 million sq ft of developable area. Ranked third in Mumbai by new launches and sales (Jan 2023 to Mar 2026, JLL).

objects.purpose: Repayment/pre-payment of certain borrowings of the Company
Investment in wholly owned subsidiaries Runwal Residency Pvt Ltd and Evie Real Estate Pvt Ltd for repayment/pre-payment of their borrowings
Funding acquisitions of future real estate projects and general corporate purposes (capped at 35% of gross proceeds; amount left blank in RHP)

promoters.background: Subodh Subhash Runwal leads the group, which traces its origins to the legacy Runwal group founded in 1978 by his father Subhash Runwal; he joined Wheelabrator Alloy Castings in 1995 and the group emerged as a separate entity in 2016.

concentration.note: Retail homebuyer model, no single-customer concentration disclosed. 66.65% of developable area is in Mumbai and 84.39% of developable area (93.93% of sales) is residential.

litigation_note: Multiple criminal, tax, regulatory and civil proceedings are outstanding against the Company, Promoter, Directors and subsidiaries. Contingent liabilities total Rs 7,980.08 crore, including Rs 629.28 crore of disputed direct and indirect tax matters.
strengths: Ranked third in Mumbai by new launches and sales (2.33% and 2.46% share, Jan 2023 to Mar 2026) and first in sales in the eastern suburbs.
Large pipeline: 28 ongoing and 33 upcoming projects with 76.29 million sq ft, giving long visibility on future cash flows.
Sales value grew from Rs 1,528 crore in FY24 to Rs 2,354 crore in FY26; units sold rose from 1,688 to 2,182.
Revenue rose 78% in FY26 to Rs 1,799 crore; EBITDA nearly doubled to Rs 350 crore and PAT margin improved to 10.3%.
Established Runwal brand since 1978 that commands price premiums in Kanjurmarg and Mulund per JLL.
Townships expertise (Runwal Gardens, My City) with integrated schools, malls and retail; asset-light JDA/DA models also used.
Expanding into luxury (7 Mahalaxmi, Girgaum) and western Mumbai alongside affordable and mid-income housing.
IND BBB+/Stable rating and funding relationships with IndusInd, ICICI, HDFC Capital, Kotak, Tata Capital and Piramal.

risks.title: Very high leverage
risks.detail: Borrowings of Rs 2,909 crore at Mar-26 against net worth of Rs 768 crore; net debt/equity 3.29x (4.64x in FY25). IPO raises only Rs 500 crore, of which Rs 325 crore goes to debt repayment.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow every year
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was -Rs 549 crore (FY24), -Rs 198 crore (FY25) and -Rs 181 crore (FY26) despite reported profits, as cash is tied up in inventory and land.

risks.title: Large contingent liabilities and guarantees
risks.detail: Contingent liabilities of Rs 7,980 crore, including Rs 1,840 crore corporate guarantees and Rs 629 crore disputed tax; Rs 5,490 crore of personal guarantees received support borrowings.

risks.title: Geographic concentration in Mumbai
risks.detail: 66.65% of developable area is in Mumbai and almost all other projects are in the Mumbai region; a local downturn or regulatory change would hit the whole business.

risks.title: Heavy reliance on future projects and execution delays
risks.detail: 28 ongoing and 33 upcoming projects are 86.33% of developable area; 18 projects sought MahaRERA extensions and many have 12 to 54 month construction delays. A Bandra SRA developer appointment was terminated on 25 Aug 2026.

risks.title: Unsold inventory and lumpy revenue
risks.detail: 7,072 unsold units (7.55 msf) at Mar-26. Revenue swung from Rs 2,409 crore to Rs 1,008 crore to Rs 1,799 crore over FY24-26 because revenue is recognised on project completion.

risks.title: Related-party dealings flagged by auditors
risks.detail: Auditors of the Company and Runwal Residency flagged certain related party transactions as prejudicial to the entity (for example a Rs 179.68 million balance outstanding), plus large group company transactions.

risks.title: Promoter control and valuation
risks.detail: Promoter holds 80.89% pre-issue and will keep control; peers trade at P/E of 21x to 58x versus company FY26 EPS of Rs 16.74, with price band not yet set. Litigation is outstanding against Company, promoter and directors.

notes: FY24-FY26 Restated Consolidated; RHP amounts in Rs million converted to Rs crore. pdftotext tables were garbled and reconstructed with cross-checks (total assets, EBITDA, PBT, PAT, cash flow and net worth all reconcile). PAT is total restated profit incl. non-controlling interest; PAT attributable to owners is Rs 209.29 cr (FY26), 78.39 cr, 75.49 cr and drives EPS and RoNW. Net worth is ICDR-defined (excludes capital reserves); total equity is Rs 844.82 cr, 485.08 cr, 451.08 cr. Reserves equal Other equity. pbt is after share of JV loss. cash_and_bank is cash and cash equivalents only (excludes bank balances). debt_equity is the RHP net debt/total equity ratio. current_ratio is computed from the balance sheet. Runwal My City (Horizon Projects) became a subsidiary from 1 Apr 2025, so earlier operating KPIs are not like-for-like. Price band, issue shares, P/E and post-issue holding are blank in the RHP. ROCE and ROE not disclosed. Fresh issue only (Rs 500 cr incl. up to Rs 3.5 cr employee reservation); no OFS. Anchor 30% is up to 60% of the 50% QIB portion. 6,341,436 shares issued on CCD conversion on 28 Aug 2026 are in the 131,391,436 pre-issue shares (FY26 NAV and EPS use 125.05 million shares). Litigation aggregate amount columns were garbled and not quantified. Promoter plus promoter group hold 95.16% fully diluted. Q1FY27 stub not provided in summary tables.
